title: Crab Derby, 2013 · after
logline: The Saturday after: the flyer on the wall in Maria's hand, better than his, and Wood at the wall comparing it to the twenty-eight before it. Gully beside him. Gully says what Wood thinks; Wood says the rest.

panels.composition: The wall with twenty-nine flyers. WOOD and GULLY before it. BARNABY.

image.prompt: two men standing before a shingle wall with a long row of flyers, an old dog beside them, black ink with one spot tone

panels.composition: The newest flyer, close: the crab in a hand that isn't Wood's, cleaner.

image.prompt: close on a fresh paper flyer with a cleanly lettered heading and a neatly drawn crab, black ink with one spot tone
a stocky man in an apron looking at a wall of flyers and speaking sideways, black ink with one spot tone

balloons.text: It's better. Don't tell her I said.

image.prompt: a thin man looking at a flyer on a wall and speaking quietly, black ink with one spot tone

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
